note: Controlled longitudinal re-explanation evaluation (Phase 3 / Gate 9). Each persona lives through sessions. In every session the user makes the same fact-dependent requests (probes). A probe SUCCEEDS when the context the system would answer from contains the probe's current value and does not offer a stale value as current; otherwise the user must RE-EXPLAIN, and the explain utterance becomes part of that system's knowledge (ingested through the production E6 path for the World Model; appended to the history for memory). After a session's probes, the session's world changes are said. Rate per session = re-explanations / probes. Intended direction: DOWN. Authored before any run by the engineer who built the system (independence not met; disclosed). Values are chosen to be unambiguous substrings for a deterministic presence check.
